category: consumer cloud drive sold in 3/12/25/50 TB blocks

free_tier.stated: PREMIUM 3 TB $6.50/mo · MAX 12 TB $16/mo · ULTRA 25 TB $32/mo · ULTIMATE 50 TB $64/mo

egress.terms: VERBATIM per-tier transfer allowance: PREMIUM "30 TB for data transfer/month", MAX "150 TB", ULTRA "300 TB", ULTIMATE "600 TB". So egress is ~12x stored capacity per month, resetting monthly — not unlimited, but 12 full restores of the whole account per month is effectively unmetered for any read pattern for a user has.

interface_detail: Native rclone backend (`ulozto`, added v1.66, Tier 3), REST/resumable upload API, CDN download links
tooling: rclone `ulozto:` — first-class, not a WebDAV fallback. Needs an app_token from https://uloz.to/upload-resumable-api-beta
chaining: rclone mount or `rclone serve s3`/`serve webdav` in front, then Cloudflare. Single namespace, no chunking needed.
limits_note: rclone backend does NOT implement About/`--drive-*` free-space query (docs say the endpoint is not exposed in the API) so `mfs`/quota policies cannot see remaining space — declare total size manually. No per-file size limit stated on the price page. No S3 API.
reliability_note: Czech provider (Uloz.to/Kramerius) that pivoted from a public file locker to a paid private drive after EU DSM pressure in 2023-24. rclone forum users report no download speed limits and working mounts; Assume the ladder can move.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: user confirms 200 TB/$64 line and 'no file size restrictions', and 'they even give a discount for yearly payments'

price_per_tb_month: $1.28/TB/mo at the 25 TB tier ($32) and at the 50 TB tier ($64). 5 TB workload: buy the 12 TB tier = $1.33/TB/mo. 20 TB workload: buy the 25 TB tier = $1.28/TB/mo. Cheapest genuine $/TB/mo of anything verified in this dossier.
